g.text: ATMOSPHERIC COLUMN C-101 - UPPER SECTION & PUMPAROUNDS
1. Trays 26-41, flash zone and bottoms on CFU-100-PR-PID-006. Trays 1-5 Monel-lined; 410S trays below.
2. Pumparound return temperatures controlled by exchanger bypass (TIC-1041/1043/1045 on PID-001/003).
3. PSV-1001: 4 x T orifice on C-101 top head, CSO inlet/outlet blocks; discharge to closed flare header.
4. Side-stripper draws / vapour returns: control on CFU-100-PR-PID-008.
5. Line numbers: <NPS>-<fluid>-<area>-<seq>-<class>-<insulation> per CONVENTIONS; see line list CFU-000-PI-LL-001.
6. All vents / drains 3/4" min. with blind or cap; HPV/LPD to piping specification. Valve sizes = line size UNO.
7. Instrument tags per ISA-5.1; index CFU-000-IC-IDX-001. SIS functions per SRS (SIF tags shown in interlocks).
ID 6.9 m (top/main) / 4.1 m (stripping) x 36.0 m T/T
MAT'L CS + 410S clad below tray 10; Monel 400 lined top head & trays
